rule: Each entry is one ledger row that failed clause (b) or (c) of scripts/check_lean_paper_propagation.py when the check was introduced, with the exact names that failed and why. A failure outside this list fails the check. A listed name that now passes also fails the check, so the change that repairs a row removes its entry and the list only shrinks. The check also refuses any entry outside the set it was introduced with.
